child.title: Can your pup call you?
child.message: When your pup is hungry, thirsty, dirty or needs a walk, we'll send you a notification. We never send anything during school or sleep (quiet hours).

parent.title: Pet care notifications
parent.message: We'll let you know when your child hasn't looked after their pet for over an hour, or when a pet gets sick or goes to the shelter. We never send anything during quiet hours. Notifications never include children's names.
